name: BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment.NonEquivocation.binding
statement:
theorem NonEquivocation.binding
    {hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest}
    (hashForbidsEquivocation : NonEquivocation hash) :
    Binding hash
proof:
:= by
  intros commitment left right
  by_cases same_bits : left.opening.bit = right.opening.bit
  · exact same_bits
  · apply False.elim
    apply hashForbidsEquivocation
    constructor
    exact same_bits

end BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

inductive Bit where
  | zero
  | one
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

end BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

namespace BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

structure Opening (Nonce : Type) where
  bit : Bit
  nonce : Nonce

theorem openings_with_distinct_bits_are_distinct {Nonce : Type}
    (left right : Opening Nonce)
    (hdiff : left.bit ≠ right.bit) : left ≠ right := by
  exact mt (congrArg Opening.bit) hdiff

abbrev Commitment (Digest : Type) := Digest

def commit
    (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest)
    (bit : Bit)
    (nonce : Nonce) :
    Commitment Digest :=
  hash bit nonce

def Verifies
    (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest)
    (c : Commitment Digest)
    (opening : Opening Nonce) :
    Prop :=
  commit hash opening.bit opening.nonce = c

theorem commitment_verifies_against_original_opening
    (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest)
    (bit : Bit)
    (nonce : Nonce) :
    Verifies hash (commit hash bit nonce) ⟨bit, nonce⟩ := by
  rfl

end BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

namespace BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

structure ValidOpening (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest) (c : Commitment Digest) where
  opening : Opening Nonce
  valid : Verifies hash c opening

def Binding (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest) : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Commitment Digest) (left right : ValidOpening hash c),
    left.opening.bit = right.opening.bit

end BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

namespace BtcVerified.BitVM.BitCommitment

structure Equivocation (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest) where
  commitment : Commitment Digest
  left : ValidOpening hash commitment
  right : ValidOpening hash commitment
  bits_distinct : left.opening.bit ≠ right.opening.bit

def NonEquivocation (hash : Bit → Nonce → Digest) : Prop := Equivocation hash → False

namespace BtcVerified.Serialize

class Codec (α : Type) where
  encode : α → List UInt8
  decode : List UInt8 → Option (α × List UInt8)
  decode_encode : ∀ (a : α) (rest : List UInt8), decode (encode a ++ rest) = some (a, rest)
  decode_canonical : ∀ (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (rest : List UInt8),
    decode bs = some (a, rest) → bs = encode a ++ rest

def decodeProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) : Option ((α × β) × List UInt8) := do
  let (a, rest) ← Codec.decode (α := α) bs
  let (b, rest') ← Codec.decode (α := β) rest
  return ((a, b), rest')

theorem decodeProd_encode {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd ((Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest) = some ((a, b), rest) := by
  unfold decodeProd
  simp only [List.append_assoc, Option.bind_eq_bind, Codec.decode_encode,
    Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]

theorem decodeProd_canonical {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd bs = some ((a, b), rest) →
    bs = (Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest := by
  intro h
  unfold decodeProd at h
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨a', r1⟩, hd, ⟨b', r2⟩, hd2, ⟨ha, hb⟩, hr⟩ := h
  subst ha; subst hb; subst hr
  rw [Codec.decode_canonical bs a' r1 hd, Codec.decode_canonical r1 b' r2 hd2,
    List.append_assoc]

instance instCodecProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β] : Codec (α × β) where
  encode p := Codec.encode p.1 ++ Codec.encode p.2
  decode := decodeProd
  decode_encode := fun (a, b) rest => decodeProd_encode a b rest
  decode_canonical := fun bs (a, b) rest h => decodeProd_canonical bs a b rest h

def decodeByte : List UInt8 → Option (UInt8 × List UInt8)
  | [] => none
  | b :: bs => some (b, bs)

def encodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → BitVec (8 * n) → List UInt8
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, v => UInt8.ofBitVec (v.setWidth 8) :: encodeBitVecLE n ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n))

def decodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → List UInt8 → Option (BitVec (8 * n) × List UInt8)
  | 0, bs => some (0#0, bs)
  | n + 1, bs => do
    let (b, bs') ← decodeByte bs
    let (hi, rest) ← decodeBitVecLE n bs'
    return (hi ++ b.toBitVec, rest)

private theorem setWidth_append_low {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    (hi ++ lo).setWidth 8 = lo := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi8
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  simp [hi8]

private theorem setWidth_ushiftRight_append {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    ((hi ++ lo) >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n) = hi := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hin
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  have h1 : ¬ (8 + i < 8) := by omega
  have h2 : 8 + i - 8 = i := by omega
  rw [if_neg h1, h2]
  simp [hin]

private theorem append_split {n : Nat} (v : BitVec (8 * (n + 1))) :
    ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n)) ++ (v.setWidth 8) = v := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hilt
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  by_cases h8 : i < 8
  · rw [if_pos h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]; simp [h8]
  · rw [if_neg h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight]
    have h1 : i - 8 < 8 * n := by omega
    have h2 : 8 + (i - 8) = i := by omega
    rw [h2]; simp [h1]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n (encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest) = some (v, rest) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v rest
    have hv : v = 0#0 := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq; intro i hi; exact absurd hi (by omega)
    subst hv
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro v rest
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte,
      Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, ih, Option.pure_def]
    rw [append_split v]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_canonical :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, rest) → bs = encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro bs v rest h
    simp only [decodeBitVecLE, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.nil_append, h.2]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs v rest h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte] at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      simp only [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some,
        Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨hi, r⟩, hd, hv, hr'⟩ := h
      have ihbs := ih bs' hi r hd
      subst hr'; subst hv
      simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, setWidth_append_low,
        setWidth_ushiftRight_append, UInt8.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ihbs]

theorem encodeBitVecLE_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)), (encodeBitVecLE n v).length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro v; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro v; simp [encodeBitVecLE, List.length_cons, ih]

@[reducible] def bitVecCodecLE (n : Nat) : Codec (BitVec (8 * n)) where
  encode := encodeBitVecLE n
  decode := decodeBitVecLE n
  decode_encode := decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE n
  decode_canonical := decodeBitVecLE_canonical n

@[reducible] def Codec.ofEquiv {α β : Type} (e : α ≃ β) (cb : Codec β) : Codec α where
  encode a := cb.encode (e a)
  decode bs := (cb.decode bs).map (fun p => (e.symm p.1, p.2))
  decode_encode a rest := by
    rw [cb.decode_encode (e a) rest]
    simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  decode_canonical bs a rest h := by
    cases hdec : cb.decode bs with
    | none => rw [hdec] at h; simp [Option.map] at h
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨b, rest'⟩ := p
      rw [hdec] at h
      simp only [Option.map, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hb, hr⟩ := h
      subst hr
      have hb' : b = e a := (Equiv.symm_apply_eq e).mp hb
      subst hb'
      exact cb.decode_canonical bs (e a) rest' hdec

instance instCodecUInt32 : Codec UInt32 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt32.toBitVec, UInt32.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 4)

end BtcVerified.Serialize

abbrev Bytes (n : Nat) := { bytes : List UInt8 // bytes.length = n }

namespace Serialize

def decodeBytes (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n × List UInt8) :=
  if h : n ≤ bs.length then
    some (⟨bs.take n, List.length_take_of_le h⟩, bs.drop n)
  else none

instance instCodecBytes (n : Nat) : Codec (Bytes n) where
  encode bs := bs.1
  decode := decodeBytes n
  decode_encode bs rest := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := bs
    subst hl
    simp [decodeBytes]
  decode_canonical bs value rest hdec := by
    simp only [decodeBytes] at hdec
    split at hdec
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff] at hdec
      rw [← hdec.2, ← hdec.1, List.take_append_drop]
    · simp at hdec

end Serialize

open BtcVerified.Serialize

abbrev Hash256 := Bytes 32

structure BlockHeader where
  version : UInt32
  prevBlockHash : Hash256
  merkleRoot : Hash256
  time : UInt32
  bits : UInt32
  nonce : UInt32
  deriving DecidableEq

def BlockHeader.equivProd :
    BlockHeader ≃ (UInt32 × Hash256 × Hash256 × UInt32 × UInt32 × UInt32) where
  toFun h := (h.version, h.prevBlockHash, h.merkleRoot, h.time, h.bits, h.nonce)
  invFun p := ⟨p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

instance instCodecBlockHeader : Codec BlockHeader :=
  Codec.ofEquiv BlockHeader.equivProd inferInstance

end BtcVerified

def roundConstants : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,

  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
  0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
  0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
  0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2]

def initialHash : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]

@[inline] def rotr (x : UInt32) (n : UInt32) : UInt32 := (x >>> n) ||| (x <<< (32 - n))

@[inline] def beWord (b0 b1 b2 b3 : UInt8) : UInt32 :=
  (b0.toUInt32 <<< 24) ||| (b1.toUInt32 <<< 16) ||| (b2.toUInt32 <<< 8) ||| b3.toUInt32

@[inline] def wordBytes (w : UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def word64Bytes (w : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 56).toUInt8, (w >>> 48).toUInt8, (w >>> 40).toUInt8, (w >>> 32).toUInt8,
   (w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def pad (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := msg.length
  let zeros := (64 - (len + 9) % 64) % 64
  msg ++ 0x80 :: List.replicate zeros 0x00 ++ word64Bytes (UInt64.ofNat (len * 8))

def compress (state block : Array UInt32) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut w : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 64 0
  for i in [0:16] do
    w := w.set! i block[i]!
  for i in [16:64] do
    let w15 := w[i - 15]!
    let w2 := w[i - 2]!
    let s0 := rotr w15 7 ^^^ rotr w15 18 ^^^ (w15 >>> 3)
    let s1 := rotr w2 17 ^^^ rotr w2 19 ^^^ (w2 >>> 10)
    w := w.set! i (w[i - 16]! + s0 + w[i - 7]! + s1)
  let mut a := state[0]!
  let mut b := state[1]!
  let mut c := state[2]!
  let mut d := state[3]!
  let mut e := state[4]!
  let mut f := state[5]!
  let mut g := state[6]!
  let mut h := state[7]!
  for i in [0:64] do
    let s1 := rotr e 6 ^^^ rotr e 11 ^^^ rotr e 25
    let ch := (e &&& f) ^^^ (~~~e &&& g)
    let t1 := h + s1 + ch + roundConstants[i]! + w[i]!
    let s0 := rotr a 2 ^^^ rotr a 13 ^^^ rotr a 22
    let maj := (a &&& b) ^^^ (a &&& c) ^^^ (b &&& c)
    let t2 := s0 + maj
    h := g; g := f; f := e; e := d + t1; d := c; c := b; b := a; a := t1 + t2
  return #[state[0]! + a, state[1]! + b, state[2]! + c, state[3]! + d,
           state[4]! + e, state[5]! + f, state[6]! + g, state[7]! + h]

def toWords (bytes : Array UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut ws : Array UInt32 := Array.mkEmpty (bytes.size / 4)
  for i in [0:bytes.size / 4] do
    ws := ws.push (beWord bytes[4 * i]! bytes[4 * i + 1]! bytes[4 * i + 2]! bytes[4 * i + 3]!)
  return ws

def sha256State (msg : List UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let words := toWords (pad msg).toArray
  let mut state := initialHash
  for b in [0:words.size / 16] do
    let mut block : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 16 0
    for j in [0:16] do
      block := block.set! j words[16 * b + j]!
    state := compress state block
  return state

def stateBytes (s : Array UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  wordBytes s[0]! ++ wordBytes s[1]! ++ wordBytes s[2]! ++ wordBytes s[3]!
    ++ wordBytes s[4]! ++ wordBytes s[5]! ++ wordBytes s[6]! ++ wordBytes s[7]!

def sha256 (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := stateBytes (sha256State msg)

def sha256d (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := sha256 (sha256 msg)

theorem sha256_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256 msg).length = 32 := by
  simp [sha256, stateBytes, wordBytes]

theorem sha256d_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256d msg).length = 32 :=
  sha256_length _

end BtcVerified.Sha256

namespace BtcVerified.Serialize

class Codec (α : Type) where
  encode : α → List UInt8
  decode : List UInt8 → Option (α × List UInt8)
  decode_encode : ∀ (a : α) (rest : List UInt8), decode (encode a ++ rest) = some (a, rest)
  decode_canonical : ∀ (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (rest : List UInt8),
    decode bs = some (a, rest) → bs = encode a ++ rest

theorem encode_injective {α : Type} [Codec α] {a b : α}
    (h : Codec.encode a = Codec.encode b) : a = b := by
  have ha := Codec.decode_encode a ([] : List UInt8)
  have hb := Codec.decode_encode b ([] : List UInt8)
  rw [List.append_nil] at ha hb
  rw [h, hb] at ha
  simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at ha
  exact ha.1.symm

def decodeProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) : Option ((α × β) × List UInt8) := do
  let (a, rest) ← Codec.decode (α := α) bs
  let (b, rest') ← Codec.decode (α := β) rest
  return ((a, b), rest')

theorem decodeProd_encode {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd ((Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest) = some ((a, b), rest) := by
  unfold decodeProd
  simp only [List.append_assoc, Option.bind_eq_bind, Codec.decode_encode,
    Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]

theorem decodeProd_canonical {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd bs = some ((a, b), rest) →
    bs = (Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest := by
  intro h
  unfold decodeProd at h
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨a', r1⟩, hd, ⟨b', r2⟩, hd2, ⟨ha, hb⟩, hr⟩ := h
  subst ha; subst hb; subst hr
  rw [Codec.decode_canonical bs a' r1 hd, Codec.decode_canonical r1 b' r2 hd2,
    List.append_assoc]

instance instCodecProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β] : Codec (α × β) where
  encode p := Codec.encode p.1 ++ Codec.encode p.2
  decode := decodeProd
  decode_encode := fun (a, b) rest => decodeProd_encode a b rest
  decode_canonical := fun bs (a, b) rest h => decodeProd_canonical bs a b rest h

def decodeByte : List UInt8 → Option (UInt8 × List UInt8)
  | [] => none
  | b :: bs => some (b, bs)

def encodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → BitVec (8 * n) → List UInt8
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, v => UInt8.ofBitVec (v.setWidth 8) :: encodeBitVecLE n ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n))

def decodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → List UInt8 → Option (BitVec (8 * n) × List UInt8)
  | 0, bs => some (0#0, bs)
  | n + 1, bs => do
    let (b, bs') ← decodeByte bs
    let (hi, rest) ← decodeBitVecLE n bs'
    return (hi ++ b.toBitVec, rest)

private theorem setWidth_append_low {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    (hi ++ lo).setWidth 8 = lo := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi8
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  simp [hi8]

private theorem setWidth_ushiftRight_append {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    ((hi ++ lo) >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n) = hi := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hin
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  have h1 : ¬ (8 + i < 8) := by omega
  have h2 : 8 + i - 8 = i := by omega
  rw [if_neg h1, h2]
  simp [hin]

private theorem append_split {n : Nat} (v : BitVec (8 * (n + 1))) :
    ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n)) ++ (v.setWidth 8) = v := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hilt
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  by_cases h8 : i < 8
  · rw [if_pos h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]; simp [h8]
  · rw [if_neg h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight]
    have h1 : i - 8 < 8 * n := by omega
    have h2 : 8 + (i - 8) = i := by omega
    rw [h2]; simp [h1]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),

  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v rest
    have hv : v = 0#0 := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq; intro i hi; exact absurd hi (by omega)
    subst hv
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro v rest
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte,
      Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, ih, Option.pure_def]
    rw [append_split v]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_canonical :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, rest) → bs = encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro bs v rest h
    simp only [decodeBitVecLE, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.nil_append, h.2]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs v rest h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte] at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      simp only [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some,
        Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨hi, r⟩, hd, hv, hr'⟩ := h
      have ihbs := ih bs' hi r hd
      subst hr'; subst hv
      simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, setWidth_append_low,
        setWidth_ushiftRight_append, UInt8.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ihbs]

theorem encodeBitVecLE_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)), (encodeBitVecLE n v).length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro v; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro v; simp [encodeBitVecLE, List.length_cons, ih]

  encode := encodeBitVecLE n
  decode := decodeBitVecLE n
  decode_encode := decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE n
  decode_canonical := decodeBitVecLE_canonical n

@[reducible] def Codec.ofEquiv {α β : Type} (e : α ≃ β) (cb : Codec β) : Codec α where
  encode a := cb.encode (e a)
  decode bs := (cb.decode bs).map (fun p => (e.symm p.1, p.2))
  decode_encode a rest := by
    rw [cb.decode_encode (e a) rest]
    simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  decode_canonical bs a rest h := by
    cases hdec : cb.decode bs with
    | none => rw [hdec] at h; simp [Option.map] at h
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨b, rest'⟩ := p
      rw [hdec] at h
      simp only [Option.map, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hb, hr⟩ := h
      subst hr
      have hb' : b = e a := (Equiv.symm_apply_eq e).mp hb
      subst hb'
      exact cb.decode_canonical bs (e a) rest' hdec

def initialHash : Array UInt32 := #[

@[inline] def rotr (x : UInt32) (n : UInt32) : UInt32 := (x >>> n) ||| (x <<< (32 - n))

@[inline] def beWord (b0 b1 b2 b3 : UInt8) : UInt32 :=
  (b0.toUInt32 <<< 24) ||| (b1.toUInt32 <<< 16) ||| (b2.toUInt32 <<< 8) ||| b3.toUInt32

@[inline] def wordBytes (w : UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def word64Bytes (w : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 56).toUInt8, (w >>> 48).toUInt8, (w >>> 40).toUInt8, (w >>> 32).toUInt8,
   (w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def pad (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := msg.length
  let zeros := (64 - (len + 9) % 64) % 64
  msg ++ 0x80 :: List.replicate zeros 0x00 ++ word64Bytes (UInt64.ofNat (len * 8))

def compress (state block : Array UInt32) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut w : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 64 0
  for i in [0:16] do
    w := w.set! i block[i]!
  for i in [16:64] do
    let w15 := w[i - 15]!
    let w2 := w[i - 2]!
    let s0 := rotr w15 7 ^^^ rotr w15 18 ^^^ (w15 >>> 3)
    let s1 := rotr w2 17 ^^^ rotr w2 19 ^^^ (w2 >>> 10)
    w := w.set! i (w[i - 16]! + s0 + w[i - 7]! + s1)
  let mut a := state[0]!
  let mut b := state[1]!
  let mut c := state[2]!
  let mut d := state[3]!
  let mut e := state[4]!
  let mut f := state[5]!
  let mut g := state[6]!
  let mut h := state[7]!
  for i in [0:64] do
    let s1 := rotr e 6 ^^^ rotr e 11 ^^^ rotr e 25
    let ch := (e &&& f) ^^^ (~~~e &&& g)
    let t1 := h + s1 + ch + roundConstants[i]! + w[i]!
    let s0 := rotr a 2 ^^^ rotr a 13 ^^^ rotr a 22
    let maj := (a &&& b) ^^^ (a &&& c) ^^^ (b &&& c)
    let t2 := s0 + maj
    h := g; g := f; f := e; e := d + t1; d := c; c := b; b := a; a := t1 + t2
  return #[state[0]! + a, state[1]! + b, state[2]! + c, state[3]! + d,
           state[4]! + e, state[5]! + f, state[6]! + g, state[7]! + h]

def toWords (bytes : Array UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut ws : Array UInt32 := Array.mkEmpty (bytes.size / 4)
  for i in [0:bytes.size / 4] do
    ws := ws.push (beWord bytes[4 * i]! bytes[4 * i + 1]! bytes[4 * i + 2]! bytes[4 * i + 3]!)
  return ws

def sha256State (msg : List UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let words := toWords (pad msg).toArray
  let mut state := initialHash
  for b in [0:words.size / 16] do
    let mut block : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 16 0
    for j in [0:16] do
      block := block.set! j words[16 * b + j]!
    state := compress state block
  return state

def stateBytes (s : Array UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  wordBytes s[0]! ++ wordBytes s[1]! ++ wordBytes s[2]! ++ wordBytes s[3]!
    ++ wordBytes s[4]! ++ wordBytes s[5]! ++ wordBytes s[6]! ++ wordBytes s[7]!

def sha256 (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := stateBytes (sha256State msg)

def sha256d (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := sha256 (sha256 msg)

theorem sha256_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256 msg).length = 32 := by
  simp [sha256, stateBytes, wordBytes]

theorem sha256d_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256d msg).length = 32 :=
  sha256_length _

class Codec (α : Type) where
  encode : α → List UInt8
  decode : List UInt8 → Option (α × List UInt8)
  decode_encode : ∀ (a : α) (rest : List UInt8), decode (encode a ++ rest) = some (a, rest)
  decode_canonical : ∀ (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (rest : List UInt8),
    decode bs = some (a, rest) → bs = encode a ++ rest

theorem encode_injective {α : Type} [Codec α] {a b : α}
    (h : Codec.encode a = Codec.encode b) : a = b := by
  have ha := Codec.decode_encode a ([] : List UInt8)
  have hb := Codec.decode_encode b ([] : List UInt8)
  rw [List.append_nil] at ha hb
  rw [h, hb] at ha
  simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at ha
  exact ha.1.symm

def decodeProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) : Option ((α × β) × List UInt8) := do
  let (a, rest) ← Codec.decode (α := α) bs
  let (b, rest') ← Codec.decode (α := β) rest
  return ((a, b), rest')

theorem decodeProd_encode {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd ((Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest) = some ((a, b), rest) := by
  unfold decodeProd
  simp only [List.append_assoc, Option.bind_eq_bind, Codec.decode_encode,
    Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]

theorem decodeProd_canonical {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd bs = some ((a, b), rest) →
    bs = (Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest := by
  intro h
  unfold decodeProd at h
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨a', r1⟩, hd, ⟨b', r2⟩, hd2, ⟨ha, hb⟩, hr⟩ := h
  subst ha; subst hb; subst hr
  rw [Codec.decode_canonical bs a' r1 hd, Codec.decode_canonical r1 b' r2 hd2,
    List.append_assoc]

instance instCodecProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β] : Codec (α × β) where
  encode p := Codec.encode p.1 ++ Codec.encode p.2
  decode := decodeProd
  decode_encode := fun (a, b) rest => decodeProd_encode a b rest
  decode_canonical := fun bs (a, b) rest h => decodeProd_canonical bs a b rest h

def decodeByte : List UInt8 → Option (UInt8 × List UInt8)
  | [] => none
  | b :: bs => some (b, bs)

def encodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → BitVec (8 * n) → List UInt8
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, v => UInt8.ofBitVec (v.setWidth 8) :: encodeBitVecLE n ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n))

def decodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → List UInt8 → Option (BitVec (8 * n) × List UInt8)
  | 0, bs => some (0#0, bs)
  | n + 1, bs => do
    let (b, bs') ← decodeByte bs
    let (hi, rest) ← decodeBitVecLE n bs'
    return (hi ++ b.toBitVec, rest)

private theorem setWidth_append_low {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    (hi ++ lo).setWidth 8 = lo := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi8
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  simp [hi8]

private theorem setWidth_ushiftRight_append {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    ((hi ++ lo) >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n) = hi := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hin
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  have h1 : ¬ (8 + i < 8) := by omega
  have h2 : 8 + i - 8 = i := by omega
  rw [if_neg h1, h2]
  simp [hin]

private theorem append_split {n : Nat} (v : BitVec (8 * (n + 1))) :
    ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n)) ++ (v.setWidth 8) = v := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hilt
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  by_cases h8 : i < 8
  · rw [if_pos h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]; simp [h8]
  · rw [if_neg h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight]
    have h1 : i - 8 < 8 * n := by omega
    have h2 : 8 + (i - 8) = i := by omega
    rw [h2]; simp [h1]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n (encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest) = some (v, rest) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v rest
    have hv : v = 0#0 := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq; intro i hi; exact absurd hi (by omega)
    subst hv
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro v rest
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte,
      Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, ih, Option.pure_def]
    rw [append_split v]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_canonical :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, rest) → bs = encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro bs v rest h
    simp only [decodeBitVecLE, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.nil_append, h.2]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs v rest h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte] at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      simp only [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some,
        Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨hi, r⟩, hd, hv, hr'⟩ := h
      have ihbs := ih bs' hi r hd
      subst hr'; subst hv
      simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, setWidth_append_low,
        setWidth_ushiftRight_append, UInt8.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ihbs]

theorem encodeBitVecLE_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)), (encodeBitVecLE n v).length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro v; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro v; simp [encodeBitVecLE, List.length_cons, ih]

@[reducible] def bitVecCodecLE (n : Nat) : Codec (BitVec (8 * n)) where
  encode := encodeBitVecLE n
  decode := decodeBitVecLE n
  decode_encode := decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE n
  decode_canonical := decodeBitVecLE_canonical n

@[reducible] def Codec.ofEquiv {α β : Type} (e : α ≃ β) (cb : Codec β) : Codec α where
  encode a := cb.encode (e a)
  decode bs := (cb.decode bs).map (fun p => (e.symm p.1, p.2))
  decode_encode a rest := by
    rw [cb.decode_encode (e a) rest]
    simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  decode_canonical bs a rest h := by
    cases hdec : cb.decode bs with
    | none => rw [hdec] at h; simp [Option.map] at h
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨b, rest'⟩ := p
      rw [hdec] at h
      simp only [Option.map, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hb, hr⟩ := h
      subst hr
      have hb' : b = e a := (Equiv.symm_apply_eq e).mp hb
      subst hb'
      exact cb.decode_canonical bs (e a) rest' hdec

  decode_canonical bs value rest hdec := by
    simp only [decodeBytes] at hdec
    split at hdec
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff] at hdec
      rw [← hdec.2, ← hdec.1, List.take_append_drop]
    · simp at hdec

theorem Bytes.encode_length {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    (Codec.encode bs).length = n := Bytes.length_val bs

def roundConstants : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,

  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
  0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
  0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
  0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2]

def initialHash : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]

@[inline] def rotr (x : UInt32) (n : UInt32) : UInt32 := (x >>> n) ||| (x <<< (32 - n))

@[inline] def beWord (b0 b1 b2 b3 : UInt8) : UInt32 :=
  (b0.toUInt32 <<< 24) ||| (b1.toUInt32 <<< 16) ||| (b2.toUInt32 <<< 8) ||| b3.toUInt32

@[inline] def wordBytes (w : UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def word64Bytes (w : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 56).toUInt8, (w >>> 48).toUInt8, (w >>> 40).toUInt8, (w >>> 32).toUInt8,
   (w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def pad (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := msg.length
  let zeros := (64 - (len + 9) % 64) % 64
  msg ++ 0x80 :: List.replicate zeros 0x00 ++ word64Bytes (UInt64.ofNat (len * 8))

def compress (state block : Array UInt32) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut w : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 64 0
  for i in [0:16] do
    w := w.set! i block[i]!
  for i in [16:64] do
    let w15 := w[i - 15]!
    let w2 := w[i - 2]!
    let s0 := rotr w15 7 ^^^ rotr w15 18 ^^^ (w15 >>> 3)
    let s1 := rotr w2 17 ^^^ rotr w2 19 ^^^ (w2 >>> 10)
    w := w.set! i (w[i - 16]! + s0 + w[i - 7]! + s1)
  let mut a := state[0]!
  let mut b := state[1]!
  let mut c := state[2]!
  let mut d := state[3]!
  let mut e := state[4]!
  let mut f := state[5]!
  let mut g := state[6]!
  let mut h := state[7]!
  for i in [0:64] do
    let s1 := rotr e 6 ^^^ rotr e 11 ^^^ rotr e 25
    let ch := (e &&& f) ^^^ (~~~e &&& g)
    let t1 := h + s1 + ch + roundConstants[i]! + w[i]!
    let s0 := rotr a 2 ^^^ rotr a 13 ^^^ rotr a 22
    let maj := (a &&& b) ^^^ (a &&& c) ^^^ (b &&& c)
    let t2 := s0 + maj
    h := g; g := f; f := e; e := d + t1; d := c; c := b; b := a; a := t1 + t2
  return #[state[0]! + a, state[1]! + b, state[2]! + c, state[3]! + d,
           state[4]! + e, state[5]! + f, state[6]! + g, state[7]! + h]

def toWords (bytes : Array UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut ws : Array UInt32 := Array.mkEmpty (bytes.size / 4)
  for i in [0:bytes.size / 4] do
    ws := ws.push (beWord bytes[4 * i]! bytes[4 * i + 1]! bytes[4 * i + 2]! bytes[4 * i + 3]!)
  return ws

def sha256State (msg : List UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let words := toWords (pad msg).toArray
  let mut state := initialHash
  for b in [0:words.size / 16] do
    let mut block : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 16 0
    for j in [0:16] do
      block := block.set! j words[16 * b + j]!
    state := compress state block
  return state

def stateBytes (s : Array UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  wordBytes s[0]! ++ wordBytes s[1]! ++ wordBytes s[2]! ++ wordBytes s[3]!
    ++ wordBytes s[4]! ++ wordBytes s[5]! ++ wordBytes s[6]! ++ wordBytes s[7]!

def sha256 (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := stateBytes (sha256State msg)

def sha256d (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := sha256 (sha256 msg)

theorem sha256_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256 msg).length = 32 := by
  simp [sha256, stateBytes, wordBytes]

theorem sha256d_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256d msg).length = 32 :=
  sha256_length _

end BtcVerified.Sha256

namespace BtcVerified.Serialize

class Codec (α : Type) where
  encode : α → List UInt8
  decode : List UInt8 → Option (α × List UInt8)
  decode_encode : ∀ (a : α) (rest : List UInt8), decode (encode a ++ rest) = some (a, rest)
  decode_canonical : ∀ (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (rest : List UInt8),
    decode bs = some (a, rest) → bs = encode a ++ rest

theorem encode_injective {α : Type} [Codec α] {a b : α}
    (h : Codec.encode a = Codec.encode b) : a = b := by
  have ha := Codec.decode_encode a ([] : List UInt8)
  have hb := Codec.decode_encode b ([] : List UInt8)
  rw [List.append_nil] at ha hb
  rw [h, hb] at ha
  simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at ha
  exact ha.1.symm

def decodeProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) : Option ((α × β) × List UInt8) := do
  let (a, rest) ← Codec.decode (α := α) bs
  let (b, rest') ← Codec.decode (α := β) rest
  return ((a, b), rest')

theorem decodeProd_encode {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd ((Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest) = some ((a, b), rest) := by
  unfold decodeProd
  simp only [List.append_assoc, Option.bind_eq_bind, Codec.decode_encode,
    Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]

theorem decodeProd_canonical {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd bs = some ((a, b), rest) →
    bs = (Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest := by
  intro h
  unfold decodeProd at h
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨a', r1⟩, hd, ⟨b', r2⟩, hd2, ⟨ha, hb⟩, hr⟩ := h
  subst ha; subst hb; subst hr
  rw [Codec.decode_canonical bs a' r1 hd, Codec.decode_canonical r1 b' r2 hd2,
    List.append_assoc]

instance instCodecProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β] : Codec (α × β) where
  encode p := Codec.encode p.1 ++ Codec.encode p.2
  decode := decodeProd
  decode_encode := fun (a, b) rest => decodeProd_encode a b rest
  decode_canonical := fun bs (a, b) rest h => decodeProd_canonical bs a b rest h

def decodeByte : List UInt8 → Option (UInt8 × List UInt8)
  | [] => none
  | b :: bs => some (b, bs)

def encodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → BitVec (8 * n) → List UInt8
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, v => UInt8.ofBitVec (v.setWidth 8) :: encodeBitVecLE n ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n))

def decodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → List UInt8 → Option (BitVec (8 * n) × List UInt8)
  | 0, bs => some (0#0, bs)
  | n + 1, bs => do
    let (b, bs') ← decodeByte bs
    let (hi, rest) ← decodeBitVecLE n bs'
    return (hi ++ b.toBitVec, rest)

private theorem setWidth_append_low {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    (hi ++ lo).setWidth 8 = lo := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi8
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  simp [hi8]

private theorem setWidth_ushiftRight_append {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    ((hi ++ lo) >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n) = hi := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hin
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  have h1 : ¬ (8 + i < 8) := by omega
  have h2 : 8 + i - 8 = i := by omega
  rw [if_neg h1, h2]
  simp [hin]

private theorem append_split {n : Nat} (v : BitVec (8 * (n + 1))) :
    ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n)) ++ (v.setWidth 8) = v := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hilt
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  by_cases h8 : i < 8
  · rw [if_pos h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]; simp [h8]
  · rw [if_neg h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight]
    have h1 : i - 8 < 8 * n := by omega
    have h2 : 8 + (i - 8) = i := by omega
    rw [h2]; simp [h1]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n (encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest) = some (v, rest) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v rest
    have hv : v = 0#0 := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq; intro i hi; exact absurd hi (by omega)
    subst hv
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro v rest
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte,
      Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, ih, Option.pure_def]
    rw [append_split v]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_canonical :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, rest) → bs = encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro bs v rest h
    simp only [decodeBitVecLE, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.nil_append, h.2]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs v rest h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte] at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      simp only [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some,
        Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨hi, r⟩, hd, hv, hr'⟩ := h
      have ihbs := ih bs' hi r hd
      subst hr'; subst hv
      simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, setWidth_append_low,
        setWidth_ushiftRight_append, UInt8.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ihbs]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_of_le_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8), n ≤ bs.length →
      ∃ v, decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, bs.drop n) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun bs _ => ⟨0#0, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ih bs' (by simpa using h)
      exact ⟨v ++ b.toBitVec, by simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, hv]⟩

theorem encodeBitVecLE_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)), (encodeBitVecLE n v).length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro v; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro v; simp [encodeBitVecLE, List.length_cons, ih]

@[reducible] def bitVecCodecLE (n : Nat) : Codec (BitVec (8 * n)) where
  encode := encodeBitVecLE n
  decode := decodeBitVecLE n
  decode_encode := decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE n
  decode_canonical := decodeBitVecLE_canonical n

@[reducible] def Codec.ofEquiv {α β : Type} (e : α ≃ β) (cb : Codec β) : Codec α where
  encode a := cb.encode (e a)
  decode bs := (cb.decode bs).map (fun p => (e.symm p.1, p.2))
  decode_encode a rest := by
    rw [cb.decode_encode (e a) rest]
    simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  decode_canonical bs a rest h := by
    cases hdec : cb.decode bs with
    | none => rw [hdec] at h; simp [Option.map] at h
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨b, rest'⟩ := p
      rw [hdec] at h
      simp only [Option.map, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hb, hr⟩ := h
      subst hr
      have hb' : b = e a := (Equiv.symm_apply_eq e).mp hb
      subst hb'
      exact cb.decode_canonical bs (e a) rest' hdec

instance instCodecUInt8 : Codec UInt8 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt8.toBitVec, UInt8.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 1)

instance instCodecUInt16 : Codec UInt16 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt16.toBitVec, UInt16.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 2)

instance instCodecUInt32 : Codec UInt32 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt32.toBitVec, UInt32.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 4)

instance instCodecUInt64 : Codec UInt64 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt64.toBitVec, UInt64.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 8)

instance instCodecBitVec256 : Codec (BitVec 256) := bitVecCodecLE 32

@[reducible] def Bytes.bytes {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) : List UInt8 := bs.1

def Bytes.reverse {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) : Bytes n :=
  ⟨bs.1.reverse, by simpa only [List.length_reverse] using bs.2⟩

@[simp] theorem Bytes.val_reverse {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    bs.reverse.val = bs.val.reverse := rfl

@[simp] theorem Bytes.reverse_reverse {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    bs.reverse.reverse = bs := by
  exact Subtype.ext (List.reverse_reverse bs.val)

def Bytes.ofListExact? {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n) :=
  if h : bs.length = n then some ⟨bs, h⟩ else none

theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_eq_some_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) (out : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListExact? bs = some out ↔ bs.length = n ∧ out.val = bs := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListExact?, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_isSome_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs).isSome ↔ bs.length = n := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListExact?]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_eq_none_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs = none ↔ bs.length ≠ n := by
  simpa only [Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none] using
    not_congr (Bytes.ofListExact?_isSome_iff bs)

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_val {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListExact? bs.val = some bs := by
  exact (Bytes.ofListExact?_eq_some_iff bs.val bs).2 ⟨bs.property, rfl⟩

theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_map_reverse {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs).map Bytes.reverse =
      Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs.reverse := by
  by_cases h : bs.length = n <;> simp [Bytes.ofListExact?, Bytes.reverse, h]

def Bytes.ofListPadLeft? {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    Option (Bytes n) :=
  if h : bs.length < n then
    some ⟨List.replicate (n - bs.length) padding ++ bs,
      by simpa using Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt h)⟩
  else none

def Bytes.ofListPadRight? {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    Option (Bytes n) :=
  if h : bs.length < n then
    some ⟨bs ++ List.replicate (n - bs.length) padding,
      by simpa using Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt h)⟩
  else none

theorem Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_eq_some_iff {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8)
    (bs : List UInt8) (out : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListPadLeft? padding bs = some out ↔
      bs.length < n ∧
        out.val = List.replicate (n - bs.length) padding ++ bs := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListPadLeft?, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

theorem Bytes.ofListPadRight?_eq_some_iff {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8)
    (bs : List UInt8) (out : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListPadRight? padding bs = some out ↔
      bs.length < n ∧
        out.val = bs ++ List.replicate (n - bs.length) padding := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListPadRight?, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_isSome_iff {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8)
    (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListPadLeft? (n := n) padding bs).isSome ↔ bs.length < n := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListPadLeft?]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListPadRight?_isSome_iff {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8)
    (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListPadRight? (n := n) padding bs).isSome ↔ bs.length < n := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListPadRight?]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_eq_none_iff {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8)
    (bs : List UInt8) :
    Bytes.ofListPadLeft? (n := n) padding bs = none ↔ n ≤ bs.length := by
  simpa only [Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none, Nat.not_lt] using
    not_congr (Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_isSome_iff padding bs)

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListPadRight?_eq_none_iff {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8)
    (bs : List UInt8) :
    Bytes.ofListPadRight? (n := n) padding bs = none ↔ n ≤ bs.length := by
  simpa only [Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none, Nat.not_lt] using
    not_congr (Bytes.ofListPadRight?_isSome_iff padding bs)

theorem Bytes.parts_of_ofListPadLeft? {n : Nat} {padding : UInt8}
    {bs : List UInt8} {out : Bytes n}
    (h : Bytes.ofListPadLeft? padding bs = some out) :
    out.val.take (n - bs.length) = List.replicate (n - bs.length) padding ∧
      out.val.drop (n - bs.length) = bs := by
  simp [(Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_eq_some_iff padding bs out).mp h |>.2]

theorem Bytes.parts_of_ofListPadRight? {n : Nat} {padding : UInt8}
    {bs : List UInt8} {out : Bytes n}
    (h : Bytes.ofListPadRight? padding bs = some out) :
    out.val.take bs.length = bs ∧
      out.val.drop bs.length = List.replicate (n - bs.length) padding := by
  simp [(Bytes.ofListPadRight?_eq_some_iff padding bs out).mp h |>.2]

theorem Bytes.head?_of_ofListPadLeft? {n : Nat} {padding : UInt8}
    {bs : List UInt8} {out : Bytes n}
    (h : Bytes.ofListPadLeft? padding bs = some out) :
    out.val.head? = some padding := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hout⟩ := (Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_eq_some_iff padding bs out).mp h
  simp [hout, List.head?_replicate, (Nat.sub_ne_zero_iff_lt).2 hlen]

theorem Bytes.getLast?_of_ofListPadRight? {n : Nat} {padding : UInt8}
    {bs : List UInt8} {out : Bytes n}
    (h : Bytes.ofListPadRight? padding bs = some out) :
    out.val.getLast? = some padding := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hout⟩ := (Bytes.ofListPadRight?_eq_some_iff padding bs out).mp h
  simp [hout, List.getLast?_replicate, (Nat.sub_ne_zero_iff_lt).2 hlen]

theorem Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_map_reverse {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListPadLeft? (n := n) padding bs).map Bytes.reverse =
      Bytes.ofListPadRight? (n := n) padding bs.reverse := by
  by_cases h : bs.length < n <;>
    simp [Bytes.ofListPadLeft?, Bytes.ofListPadRight?, Bytes.reverse, h]

def Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n) :=
  if h : n < bs.length then
    some ⟨bs.drop (bs.length - n), by simpa using Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.le_of_lt h)⟩
  else none

def Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n) :=
  if h : n < bs.length then
    some ⟨bs.take n, List.length_take_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt h)⟩
  else none

theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_eq_some_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8)
    (out : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? bs = some out ↔
      n < bs.length ∧ out.val = bs.drop (bs.length - n) := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?_eq_some_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8)
    (out : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? bs = some out ↔
      n < bs.length ∧ out.val = bs.take n := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_isSome_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? (n := n) bs).isSome ↔ n < bs.length := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?_isSome_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? (n := n) bs).isSome ↔ n < bs.length := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_eq_none_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? (n := n) bs = none ↔ bs.length ≤ n := by
  simpa only [Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none, Nat.not_lt] using
    not_congr (Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_isSome_iff bs)

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?_eq_none_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? (n := n) bs = none ↔ bs.length ≤ n := by
  simpa only [Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none, Nat.not_lt] using
    not_congr (Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?_isSome_iff bs)

theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_map_reverse {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? (n := n) bs).map Bytes.reverse =
      Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? (n := n) bs.reverse := by
  by_cases h : n < bs.length
  · simp [Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?, Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?, Bytes.reverse, h,
      List.reverse_drop, Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.le_of_lt h)]
  · simp [Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?, Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?, h]

theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_of_ofListPadLeft? {n : Nat} {padding : UInt8}
    {bs : List UInt8} {out : Bytes n}
    (h : Bytes.ofListPadLeft? padding bs = some out) :
    Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? (n := bs.length) out.val =
      Bytes.ofListExact? (n := bs.length) bs := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hout⟩ := (Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_eq_some_iff padding bs out).mp h
  simp [hout, Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?, Bytes.ofListExact?, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hlen]

theorem Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?_of_ofListPadRight? {n : Nat} {padding : UInt8}
    {bs : List UInt8} {out : Bytes n}
    (h : Bytes.ofListPadRight? padding bs = some out) :
    Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? (n := bs.length) out.val =
      Bytes.ofListExact? (n := bs.length) bs := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hout⟩ := (Bytes.ofListPadRight?_eq_some_iff padding bs out).mp h
  simp [hout, Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?, Bytes.ofListExact?, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hlen]

theorem Bytes.ofListPad_isSome_eq {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListPadLeft? (n := n) padding bs).isSome =
      (Bytes.ofListPadRight? (n := n) padding bs).isSome := by
  exact Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr <| (Bytes.ofListPadLeft?_isSome_iff padding bs).trans
    (Bytes.ofListPadRight?_isSome_iff padding bs).symm

theorem Bytes.ofListTruncate_isSome_eq {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? (n := n) bs).isSome =
      (Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? (n := n) bs).isSome := by
  exact Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr <| (Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?_isSome_iff bs).trans
    (Bytes.ofListTruncateRight?_isSome_iff bs).symm

theorem Bytes.ofList_left_exactly_one {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    [(Bytes.ofListPadLeft? (n := n) padding bs).isSome,
      (Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs).isSome,
      (Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft? (n := n) bs).isSome].count true = 1 := by
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy bs.length n with h | h | h
  · have ⟨hne, hnlt⟩ : bs.length ≠ n ∧ ¬ n < bs.length := by omega
    simp [Bytes.ofListPadLeft?, Bytes.ofListExact?, Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?, h, hne, hnlt]
  · subst n
    simp [Bytes.ofListPadLeft?, Bytes.ofListExact?, Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?]
  · have ⟨hnlt, hne⟩ : ¬ bs.length < n ∧ bs.length ≠ n := by omega
    simp [Bytes.ofListPadLeft?, Bytes.ofListExact?, Bytes.ofListTruncateLeft?, h, hnlt, hne]

theorem Bytes.ofList_right_exactly_one {n : Nat} (padding : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    [(Bytes.ofListPadRight? (n := n) padding bs).isSome,
      (Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs).isSome,
      (Bytes.ofListTruncateRight? (n := n) bs).isSome].count true = 1 := by
  simpa only [← Bytes.ofListPad_isSome_eq padding bs,
    ← Bytes.ofListTruncate_isSome_eq bs] using Bytes.ofList_left_exactly_one padding bs

@[simp] theorem Bytes.length_val {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) : bs.1.length = n := bs.2

def decodeBytes (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n × List UInt8) :=
  if h : n ≤ bs.length then
    some (⟨bs.take n, List.length_take_of_le h⟩, bs.drop n)
  else none

instance instCodecBytes (n : Nat) : Codec (Bytes n) where
  encode bs := bs.1
  decode := decodeBytes n

    split at hdec
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff] at hdec

    · simp at hdec

def Collision {α β : Type*} (h : α → β) : Prop := ∃ a b : α, a ≠ b ∧ h a = h b

def CollisionResistant {α β : Type*} (h : α → β) : Prop := ¬ Collision h

theorem CollisionResistant.injective {α β : Type*} {h : α → β}
    (hcr : CollisionResistant h) {a b : α} (hab : h a = h b) : a = b := by
  by_cases hne : a = b
  · exact hne
  · exact absurd ⟨a, b, hne, hab⟩ hcr

theorem Collision.comp {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (hc : Collision (g ∘ f)) : Collision f ∨ Collision g := by
  match hc with
  | ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ =>
    by_cases hf : f a = f b
    · exact Or.inl ⟨a, b, hab, hf⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨f a, f b, hf, h⟩

theorem CollisionResistant.comp {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (hf : CollisionResistant f) (hg : CollisionResistant g) :
    CollisionResistant (g ∘ f) :=
  fun hc => (Collision.comp hc).elim hf hg

theorem Collision.comp_inner {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (hc : Collision f) : Collision (g ∘ f) := by
  match hc with
  | ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ => exact ⟨a, b, hab, congrArg g h⟩

theorem CollisionResistant.of_comp {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (h : CollisionResistant (g ∘ f)) : CollisionResistant f :=
  fun hc => h hc.comp_inner

end BtcVerified

def roundConstants : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,

  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
  0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
  0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
  0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2]

def initialHash : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]

@[inline] def rotr (x : UInt32) (n : UInt32) : UInt32 := (x >>> n) ||| (x <<< (32 - n))

@[inline] def beWord (b0 b1 b2 b3 : UInt8) : UInt32 :=
  (b0.toUInt32 <<< 24) ||| (b1.toUInt32 <<< 16) ||| (b2.toUInt32 <<< 8) ||| b3.toUInt32

@[inline] def wordBytes (w : UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def word64Bytes (w : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 56).toUInt8, (w >>> 48).toUInt8, (w >>> 40).toUInt8, (w >>> 32).toUInt8,
   (w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def pad (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := msg.length
  let zeros := (64 - (len + 9) % 64) % 64
  msg ++ 0x80 :: List.replicate zeros 0x00 ++ word64Bytes (UInt64.ofNat (len * 8))

def compress (state block : Array UInt32) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut w : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 64 0
  for i in [0:16] do
    w := w.set! i block[i]!
  for i in [16:64] do
    let w15 := w[i - 15]!
    let w2 := w[i - 2]!
    let s0 := rotr w15 7 ^^^ rotr w15 18 ^^^ (w15 >>> 3)
    let s1 := rotr w2 17 ^^^ rotr w2 19 ^^^ (w2 >>> 10)
    w := w.set! i (w[i - 16]! + s0 + w[i - 7]! + s1)
  let mut a := state[0]!
  let mut b := state[1]!
  let mut c := state[2]!
  let mut d := state[3]!
  let mut e := state[4]!
  let mut f := state[5]!
  let mut g := state[6]!
  let mut h := state[7]!
  for i in [0:64] do
    let s1 := rotr e 6 ^^^ rotr e 11 ^^^ rotr e 25
    let ch := (e &&& f) ^^^ (~~~e &&& g)
    let t1 := h + s1 + ch + roundConstants[i]! + w[i]!
    let s0 := rotr a 2 ^^^ rotr a 13 ^^^ rotr a 22
    let maj := (a &&& b) ^^^ (a &&& c) ^^^ (b &&& c)
    let t2 := s0 + maj
    h := g; g := f; f := e; e := d + t1; d := c; c := b; b := a; a := t1 + t2
  return #[state[0]! + a, state[1]! + b, state[2]! + c, state[3]! + d,
           state[4]! + e, state[5]! + f, state[6]! + g, state[7]! + h]

def toWords (bytes : Array UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut ws : Array UInt32 := Array.mkEmpty (bytes.size / 4)
  for i in [0:bytes.size / 4] do
    ws := ws.push (beWord bytes[4 * i]! bytes[4 * i + 1]! bytes[4 * i + 2]! bytes[4 * i + 3]!)
  return ws

def sha256State (msg : List UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let words := toWords (pad msg).toArray
  let mut state := initialHash
  for b in [0:words.size / 16] do
    let mut block : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 16 0
    for j in [0:16] do
      block := block.set! j words[16 * b + j]!
    state := compress state block
  return state

def stateBytes (s : Array UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  wordBytes s[0]! ++ wordBytes s[1]! ++ wordBytes s[2]! ++ wordBytes s[3]!
    ++ wordBytes s[4]! ++ wordBytes s[5]! ++ wordBytes s[6]! ++ wordBytes s[7]!

def sha256 (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := stateBytes (sha256State msg)

def sha256d (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := sha256 (sha256 msg)

theorem sha256_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256 msg).length = 32 := by
  simp [sha256, stateBytes, wordBytes]

theorem sha256d_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256d msg).length = 32 :=
  sha256_length _

abbrev Collision : Prop := BtcVerified.Collision sha256d

theorem collisionResistant_sha256d (h : CollisionResistant sha256) :
    CollisionResistant sha256d :=
  h.comp h

theorem collisionResistant_sha256_of_sha256d (h : CollisionResistant sha256d) :
    CollisionResistant sha256 :=
  CollisionResistant.of_comp (f := sha256) (g := sha256) h

theorem collisionResistant_sha256_iff_sha256d :
    CollisionResistant sha256 ↔ CollisionResistant sha256d :=
  ⟨collisionResistant_sha256d, collisionResistant_sha256_of_sha256d⟩

end BtcVerified.Sha256

theorem BlockHeader.hash_binding {h₁ h₂ : BlockHeader} (h : h₁.hash = h₂.hash) :

inductive Chain (anchor : Hash256) : Hash256 → Type where
  | nil : Chain anchor anchor
  | extend (tip : BlockHeader) (rest : Chain anchor tip.prevBlockHash) :
      Chain anchor tip.hash

def Chain.toList {a t : Hash256} : Chain a t → List BlockHeader
  | .nil => []
  | .extend tip rest => tip :: rest.toList

def Chain.append {a m t : Hash256} : Chain m t → Chain a m → Chain a t
  | .nil, c => c
  | .extend tip rest, c => .extend tip (rest.append c)

def tipHash (anchor : Hash256) : List BlockHeader → Hash256
  | [] => anchor
  | hd :: _ => hd.hash

def IsChain (anchor : Hash256) : List BlockHeader → Prop
  | [] => True
  | hd :: tl => hd.prevBlockHash = tipHash anchor tl ∧ IsChain anchor tl

instance instDecidableIsChain (a : Hash256) :
    (hs : List BlockHeader) → Decidable (IsChain a hs)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
  | _ :: tl =>
    haveI := instDecidableIsChain a tl
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

class Codec (α : Type) where
  encode : α → List UInt8
  decode : List UInt8 → Option (α × List UInt8)
  decode_encode : ∀ (a : α) (rest : List UInt8), decode (encode a ++ rest) = some (a, rest)
  decode_canonical : ∀ (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (rest : List UInt8),
    decode bs = some (a, rest) → bs = encode a ++ rest

theorem encode_injective {α : Type} [Codec α] {a b : α}
    (h : Codec.encode a = Codec.encode b) : a = b := by
  have ha := Codec.decode_encode a ([] : List UInt8)
  have hb := Codec.decode_encode b ([] : List UInt8)
  rw [List.append_nil] at ha hb
  rw [h, hb] at ha
  simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at ha
  exact ha.1.symm

def decodeProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) : Option ((α × β) × List UInt8) := do
  let (a, rest) ← Codec.decode (α := α) bs
  let (b, rest') ← Codec.decode (α := β) rest
  return ((a, b), rest')

theorem decodeProd_encode {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd ((Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest) = some ((a, b), rest) := by
  unfold decodeProd
  simp only [List.append_assoc, Option.bind_eq_bind, Codec.decode_encode,
    Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]

theorem decodeProd_canonical {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β]
    (bs : List UInt8) (a : α) (b : β) (rest : List UInt8) :
    decodeProd bs = some ((a, b), rest) →
    bs = (Codec.encode a ++ Codec.encode b) ++ rest := by
  intro h
  unfold decodeProd at h
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨a', r1⟩, hd, ⟨b', r2⟩, hd2, ⟨ha, hb⟩, hr⟩ := h
  subst ha; subst hb; subst hr
  rw [Codec.decode_canonical bs a' r1 hd, Codec.decode_canonical r1 b' r2 hd2,
    List.append_assoc]

instance instCodecProd {α β : Type} [Codec α] [Codec β] : Codec (α × β) where
  encode p := Codec.encode p.1 ++ Codec.encode p.2
  decode := decodeProd
  decode_encode := fun (a, b) rest => decodeProd_encode a b rest
  decode_canonical := fun bs (a, b) rest h => decodeProd_canonical bs a b rest h

def decodeByte : List UInt8 → Option (UInt8 × List UInt8)
  | [] => none
  | b :: bs => some (b, bs)

def encodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → BitVec (8 * n) → List UInt8
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, v => UInt8.ofBitVec (v.setWidth 8) :: encodeBitVecLE n ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n))

def decodeBitVecLE : (n : Nat) → List UInt8 → Option (BitVec (8 * n) × List UInt8)
  | 0, bs => some (0#0, bs)
  | n + 1, bs => do
    let (b, bs') ← decodeByte bs
    let (hi, rest) ← decodeBitVecLE n bs'
    return (hi ++ b.toBitVec, rest)

private theorem setWidth_append_low {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    (hi ++ lo).setWidth 8 = lo := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi8
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  simp [hi8]

private theorem setWidth_ushiftRight_append {n : Nat} (hi : BitVec (8 * n)) (lo : BitVec 8) :
    ((hi ++ lo) >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n) = hi := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hin
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight, BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  have h1 : ¬ (8 + i < 8) := by omega
  have h2 : 8 + i - 8 = i := by omega
  rw [if_neg h1, h2]
  simp [hin]

private theorem append_split {n : Nat} (v : BitVec (8 * (n + 1))) :
    ((v >>> 8).setWidth (8 * n)) ++ (v.setWidth 8) = v := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hilt
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  by_cases h8 : i < 8
  · rw [if_pos h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]; simp [h8]
  · rw [if_neg h8, BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, BitVec.getLsbD_ushiftRight]
    have h1 : i - 8 < 8 * n := by omega
    have h2 : 8 + (i - 8) = i := by omega
    rw [h2]; simp [h1]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n (encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest) = some (v, rest) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v rest
    have hv : v = 0#0 := by
      apply BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq; intro i hi; exact absurd hi (by omega)
    subst hv
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro v rest
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte,
      Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, ih, Option.pure_def]
    rw [append_split v]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_canonical :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) (v : BitVec (8 * n)) (rest : List UInt8),
      decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, rest) → bs = encodeBitVecLE n v ++ rest := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro bs v rest h
    simp only [decodeBitVecLE, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.nil_append, h.2]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs v rest h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte] at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      simp only [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some,
        Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨hi, r⟩, hd, hv, hr'⟩ := h
      have ihbs := ih bs' hi r hd
      subst hr'; subst hv
      simp only [encodeBitVecLE, List.cons_append, setWidth_append_low,
        setWidth_ushiftRight_append, UInt8.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ihbs]

theorem decodeBitVecLE_of_le_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8), n ≤ bs.length →
      ∃ v, decodeBitVecLE n bs = some (v, bs.drop n) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun bs _ => ⟨0#0, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro bs h
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs' =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ih bs' (by simpa using h)
      exact ⟨v ++ b.toBitVec, by simp [decodeBitVecLE, decodeByte, hv]⟩

theorem encodeBitVecLE_length :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (v : BitVec (8 * n)), (encodeBitVecLE n v).length = n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro v; rfl
  | succ n ih => intro v; simp [encodeBitVecLE, List.length_cons, ih]

@[reducible] def bitVecCodecLE (n : Nat) : Codec (BitVec (8 * n)) where
  encode := encodeBitVecLE n
  decode := decodeBitVecLE n
  decode_encode := decodeBitVecLE_encodeBitVecLE n
  decode_canonical := decodeBitVecLE_canonical n

@[reducible] def Codec.ofEquiv {α β : Type} (e : α ≃ β) (cb : Codec β) : Codec α where
  encode a := cb.encode (e a)
  decode bs := (cb.decode bs).map (fun p => (e.symm p.1, p.2))
  decode_encode a rest := by
    rw [cb.decode_encode (e a) rest]
    simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  decode_canonical bs a rest h := by
    cases hdec : cb.decode bs with
    | none => rw [hdec] at h; simp [Option.map] at h
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨b, rest'⟩ := p
      rw [hdec] at h
      simp only [Option.map, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨hb, hr⟩ := h
      subst hr
      have hb' : b = e a := (Equiv.symm_apply_eq e).mp hb
      subst hb'
      exact cb.decode_canonical bs (e a) rest' hdec

instance instCodecUInt8 : Codec UInt8 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt8.toBitVec, UInt8.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 1)

instance instCodecUInt16 : Codec UInt16 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt16.toBitVec, UInt16.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 2)

instance instCodecUInt32 : Codec UInt32 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt32.toBitVec, UInt32.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 4)

instance instCodecUInt64 : Codec UInt64 :=
  Codec.ofEquiv ⟨UInt64.toBitVec, UInt64.ofBitVec, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩ (bitVecCodecLE 8)

instance instCodecBitVec256 : Codec (BitVec 256) := bitVecCodecLE 32

end BtcVerified.Serialize

abbrev Bytes (n : Nat) := { bytes : List UInt8 // bytes.length = n }

@[reducible] def Bytes.bytes {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) : List UInt8 := bs.1

def Bytes.reverse {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) : Bytes n :=
  ⟨bs.1.reverse, by simpa only [List.length_reverse] using bs.2⟩

@[simp] theorem Bytes.val_reverse {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    bs.reverse.val = bs.val.reverse := rfl

@[simp] theorem Bytes.reverse_reverse {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    bs.reverse.reverse = bs := by
  exact Subtype.ext (List.reverse_reverse bs.val)

def Bytes.ofListExact? {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n) :=
  if h : bs.length = n then some ⟨bs, h⟩ else none

theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_eq_some_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) (out : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListExact? bs = some out ↔ bs.length = n ∧ out.val = bs := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListExact?, Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_isSome_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    (Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs).isSome ↔ bs.length = n := by
  simp [Bytes.ofListExact?]

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_eq_none_iff {n : Nat} (bs : List UInt8) :
    Bytes.ofListExact? (n := n) bs = none ↔ bs.length ≠ n := by
  simpa only [Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none] using
    not_congr (Bytes.ofListExact?_isSome_iff bs)

@[simp] theorem Bytes.ofListExact?_val {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    Bytes.ofListExact? bs.val = some bs := by
  exact (Bytes.ofListExact?_eq_some_iff bs.val bs).2 ⟨bs.property, rfl⟩

@[simp] theorem Bytes.length_val {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) : bs.1.length = n := bs.2

namespace Serialize

def decodeBytes (n : Nat) (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Bytes n × List UInt8) :=
  if h : n ≤ bs.length then
    some (⟨bs.take n, List.length_take_of_le h⟩, bs.drop n)
  else none

instance instCodecBytes (n : Nat) : Codec (Bytes n) where
  encode bs := bs.1
  decode := decodeBytes n
  decode_encode bs rest := by
    simp [decodeBytes]
  decode_canonical bs value rest hdec := by
    simp only [decodeBytes] at hdec
    split at hdec
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff] at hdec
      rw [← hdec.2, ← hdec.1, List.take_append_drop]
    · simp at hdec

theorem Bytes.encode_length {n : Nat} (bs : Bytes n) :
    (Codec.encode bs).length = n := Bytes.length_val bs

end Serialize

def BlockHeader.equivProd :

  invFun p := ⟨p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2.1, p.2.2.2.2.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl

def Collision {α β : Type*} (h : α → β) : Prop := ∃ a b : α, a ≠ b ∧ h a = h b

def CollisionResistant {α β : Type*} (h : α → β) : Prop := ¬ Collision h

theorem CollisionResistant.injective {α β : Type*} {h : α → β}
    (hcr : CollisionResistant h) {a b : α} (hab : h a = h b) : a = b := by
  by_cases hne : a = b
  · exact hne
  · exact absurd ⟨a, b, hne, hab⟩ hcr

theorem Collision.comp {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (hc : Collision (g ∘ f)) : Collision f ∨ Collision g := by
  match hc with
  | ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ =>
    by_cases hf : f a = f b
    · exact Or.inl ⟨a, b, hab, hf⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨f a, f b, hf, h⟩

theorem CollisionResistant.comp {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (hf : CollisionResistant f) (hg : CollisionResistant g) :
    CollisionResistant (g ∘ f) :=
  fun hc => (Collision.comp hc).elim hf hg

theorem Collision.comp_inner {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (hc : Collision f) : Collision (g ∘ f) := by
  match hc with
  | ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ => exact ⟨a, b, hab, congrArg g h⟩

theorem CollisionResistant.of_comp {α β γ : Type*} {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
    (h : CollisionResistant (g ∘ f)) : CollisionResistant f :=
  fun hc => h hc.comp_inner

end BtcVerified

namespace BtcVerified.Sha256

def roundConstants : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
  0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
  0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
  0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
  0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
  0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2]

def initialHash : Array UInt32 := #[
  0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]

@[inline] def rotr (x : UInt32) (n : UInt32) : UInt32 := (x >>> n) ||| (x <<< (32 - n))

@[inline] def beWord (b0 b1 b2 b3 : UInt8) : UInt32 :=
  (b0.toUInt32 <<< 24) ||| (b1.toUInt32 <<< 16) ||| (b2.toUInt32 <<< 8) ||| b3.toUInt32

@[inline] def wordBytes (w : UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def word64Bytes (w : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [(w >>> 56).toUInt8, (w >>> 48).toUInt8, (w >>> 40).toUInt8, (w >>> 32).toUInt8,
   (w >>> 24).toUInt8, (w >>> 16).toUInt8, (w >>> 8).toUInt8, w.toUInt8]

def pad (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  let len := msg.length
  let zeros := (64 - (len + 9) % 64) % 64
  msg ++ 0x80 :: List.replicate zeros 0x00 ++ word64Bytes (UInt64.ofNat (len * 8))

def compress (state block : Array UInt32) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut w : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 64 0
  for i in [0:16] do
    w := w.set! i block[i]!
  for i in [16:64] do
    let w15 := w[i - 15]!
    let w2 := w[i - 2]!
    let s0 := rotr w15 7 ^^^ rotr w15 18 ^^^ (w15 >>> 3)
    let s1 := rotr w2 17 ^^^ rotr w2 19 ^^^ (w2 >>> 10)
    w := w.set! i (w[i - 16]! + s0 + w[i - 7]! + s1)
  let mut a := state[0]!
  let mut b := state[1]!
  let mut c := state[2]!
  let mut d := state[3]!
  let mut e := state[4]!
  let mut f := state[5]!
  let mut g := state[6]!
  let mut h := state[7]!
  for i in [0:64] do
    let s1 := rotr e 6 ^^^ rotr e 11 ^^^ rotr e 25
    let ch := (e &&& f) ^^^ (~~~e &&& g)
    let t1 := h + s1 + ch + roundConstants[i]! + w[i]!
    let s0 := rotr a 2 ^^^ rotr a 13 ^^^ rotr a 22
    let maj := (a &&& b) ^^^ (a &&& c) ^^^ (b &&& c)
    let t2 := s0 + maj
    h := g; g := f; f := e; e := d + t1; d := c; c := b; b := a; a := t1 + t2
  return #[state[0]! + a, state[1]! + b, state[2]! + c, state[3]! + d,
           state[4]! + e, state[5]! + f, state[6]! + g, state[7]! + h]

def toWords (bytes : Array UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let mut ws : Array UInt32 := Array.mkEmpty (bytes.size / 4)
  for i in [0:bytes.size / 4] do
    ws := ws.push (beWord bytes[4 * i]! bytes[4 * i + 1]! bytes[4 * i + 2]! bytes[4 * i + 3]!)
  return ws

def sha256State (msg : List UInt8) : Array UInt32 := Id.run do
  let words := toWords (pad msg).toArray
  let mut state := initialHash
  for b in [0:words.size / 16] do
    let mut block : Array UInt32 := Array.replicate 16 0
    for j in [0:16] do
      block := block.set! j words[16 * b + j]!
    state := compress state block
  return state

def stateBytes (s : Array UInt32) : List UInt8 :=
  wordBytes s[0]! ++ wordBytes s[1]! ++ wordBytes s[2]! ++ wordBytes s[3]!
    ++ wordBytes s[4]! ++ wordBytes s[5]! ++ wordBytes s[6]! ++ wordBytes s[7]!

def sha256 (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := stateBytes (sha256State msg)

def sha256d (msg : List UInt8) : List UInt8 := sha256 (sha256 msg)

theorem sha256_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256 msg).length = 32 := by
  simp [sha256, stateBytes, wordBytes]

theorem sha256d_length (msg : List UInt8) : (sha256d msg).length = 32 :=
  sha256_length _

abbrev Collision : Prop := BtcVerified.Collision sha256d

theorem collisionResistant_sha256d (h : CollisionResistant sha256) :
    CollisionResistant sha256d :=
  h.comp h

theorem collisionResistant_sha256_of_sha256d (h : CollisionResistant sha256d) :
    CollisionResistant sha256 :=
  CollisionResistant.of_comp (f := sha256) (g := sha256) h

theorem collisionResistant_sha256_iff_sha256d :
    CollisionResistant sha256 ↔ CollisionResistant sha256d :=
  ⟨collisionResistant_sha256d, collisionResistant_sha256_of_sha256d⟩

end BtcVerified.Sha256

def BlockHeader.hash (h : BlockHeader) : Hash256 :=
  ⟨Sha256.sha256d (Codec.encode h), Sha256.sha256d_length _⟩

theorem BlockHeader.hash_binding {h₁ h₂ : BlockHeader} (h : h₁.hash = h₂.hash) :
    h₁ = h₂ ∨ Sha256.Collision := by
  by_cases he : h₁ = h₂
  · exact Or.inl he
  · exact Or.inr ⟨Codec.encode h₁, Codec.encode h₂,
      fun hc => he (encode_injective hc), congrArg Subtype.val h⟩

end BtcVerified

seal BlockHeader.hash

def BlockHeader.Extends (h₂ h₁ : BlockHeader) : Prop := h₂.prevBlockHash = h₁.hash

instance instDecidableExtends (h₂ h₁ : BlockHeader) : Decidable (h₂.Extends h₁) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ = _))

inductive Chain (anchor : Hash256) : Hash256 → Type where
  | nil : Chain anchor anchor
  | extend (tip : BlockHeader) (rest : Chain anchor tip.prevBlockHash) :
      Chain anchor tip.hash

def Chain.toList {a t : Hash256} : Chain a t → List BlockHeader
  | .nil => []
  | .extend tip rest => tip :: rest.toList

def Chain.append {a m t : Hash256} : Chain m t → Chain a m → Chain a t
  | .nil, c => c
  | .extend tip rest, c => .extend tip (rest.append c)

def tipHash (anchor : Hash256) : List BlockHeader → Hash256
  | [] => anchor
  | hd :: _ => hd.hash

def IsChain (anchor : Hash256) : List BlockHeader → Prop
  | [] => True
  | hd :: tl => hd.prevBlockHash = tipHash anchor tl ∧ IsChain anchor tl

instance instDecidableIsChain (a : Hash256) :
    (hs : List BlockHeader) → Decidable (IsChain a hs)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
  | _ :: tl =>
    haveI := instDecidableIsChain a tl
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

theorem Chain.tip_commits_aux {a₁ t₁ : Hash256} (c₁ : Chain a₁ t₁) :
    ∀ {a₂ t₂ : Hash256} (c₂ : Chain a₂ t₂), t₁ = t₂ →
      c₁.toList.length = c₂.toList.length → c₁.toList = c₂.toList ∨ Sha256.Collision := by
  induction c₁ with
  | nil =>
    intro a₂ t₂ c₂ heq hlen
    cases c₂ with
    | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
    | extend tip rest => simp [Chain.toList] at hlen
  | extend tip rest ih =>
    intro a₂ t₂ c₂ heq hlen
    cases c₂ with
    | nil => simp [Chain.toList] at hlen
    | extend tip2 rest2 =>
      rcases BlockHeader.hash_binding heq with h | h
      · subst h
        have hlen' : rest.toList.length = rest2.toList.length := by
          simpa [Chain.toList] using hlen
        rcases ih rest2 rfl hlen' with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (by simp [Chain.toList, h])
        · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inr h
